WRS is the main case study: the implementation is public, and you can try the website assistant above. The model training project below shows a separate evaluation workflow.

01 / FEATURED CASE STUDY
RAGFASTAPIPGVECTORJAVASCRIPT

WRS — a source-grounded assistant for websites

WRS turns website pages and uploaded content into a searchable knowledge base. It combines semantic and keyword retrieval, then returns answers with source links through an embeddable chat widget. The same service also supports private assistants and messaging integrations.

01 · CONTENT

Crawls static and JavaScript-rendered pages, chunks text, and indexes multilingual embeddings.

02 · RETRIEVAL

Combines pgvector similarity with PostgreSQL full-text search before composing an answer with source links.

03 · DELIVERY

FastAPI serves an embeddable website widget, private assistant views, and messaging integrations.

04 · FEEDBACK

A pilot analytics flow records low-confidence and unanswered questions, feedback, and response times for review.

The public repository documents the implementation. A public benchmark for answer quality or customer impact has not been published.

02 / MODEL ADAPTATION
QLORAMLX-LMEVALUATION

Local LLM fine-tuning for flashcards

Fine-tuned a 4-bit Qwen3-VL-8B adapter on curated and synthetic educational text to generate structured JSON flashcards. The workflow includes dataset validation, deduplication, a held-out comparison with the base model, and a published model card.

The published evaluation covers only 20 held-out passages and checks target card count. It is preliminary evidence about formatting behavior, not a measure of overall flashcard quality.
